capability: Bind every non-sentinel release package to the repository version and exact Git HEAD that produced it
searchEvidence: rg -n '\$Version|RepositoryVersion|Get-Content.*VERSION|AllowPrerelease' scripts/package.ps1 found only SemVer and SHA grammar checks; package.ps1 did not compare the requested values with root VERSION or Git HEAD

The protected release workflow separately checks its requested source identity, but direct validation packaging can otherwise emit a self-consistent manifest that names caller-supplied version and commit values unrelated to the checkout
The existing ExternalToolPolicyDryRun intentionally uses the exact 0.0.0 plus forty-zero sentinel and must remain deterministic without requiring a release commit

Independent fixed-diff review found a verify-to-build race in a preflight-only design: the invocation worktree can change after its clean HEAD check while later package reads still consume that mutable path
semanticOwner: scripts/package.ps1 owns the package source-identity preflight and exact detached source materialization before it clears staging or invokes build tooling; VERSION and the supplied current committed Git HEAD remain the canonical producers
terminalContract: Except for the exact ExternalToolPolicyDryRun 0.0.0/all-zero sentinel, packaging fails before staging cleanup or build when the semantic version differs from root VERSION, the supplied commit differs from the lowercase full current HEAD, Git identity cannot be read, the invocation worktree is not clean, or an exact clean detached worktree for that commit cannot be materialized. Every subsequent program, profile, contract, and golden read uses that private commit snapshot while artifacts are emitted to the invocation repository. The snapshot is removed on success or failure; a cleanup failure is reported and preserves the snapshot for inspection. The sentinel continues to exercise only the closed external-tool/profile package policy. No check rewrites VERSION, the invocation Git state, package bytes, firmware inputs, or release evidence.

designReview.evidence: Independent release-design review approved fail-closed Version==VERSION and Commit==HEAD identity, a clean invocation worktree, and an exact private commit materialization that closes the verify-to-build race; bypass remains limited to the exact existing 0.0.0/all-zero external-tool-policy sentinel.
